newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - March 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - March 12.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Soldier goes berserk at Anuradhapura police station killing one female home guard militia member in shooting spree.
Unknown gunmen set fire to stage being prepared for Janatha Vimukthi Peramuna rally at Kaduwela.
Police arrest five suspected Tamil rebels who were planning to disrupt the March 21 local government poll.
Justice Minister G.L. Peiris says draft of new constitution to be tabled in parliament before budget debate.
Smuggling of Tamils from northern Sri Lanka to southern India temporarily halted after drowning of 150 people when their boat capsized last month.
